title: The examples runner gives each example its __file__
author: Claude-JG
description: runTestExamples.py executes an example by exec without __file__, so an example that finds its data relative to its own file - staubliTX2blending.py and staubliTX2trajectories.py, since #3263 - fails with a NameError in the examples run, while it runs when started directly. Decided: the runner sets __file__ to the path of the example, in the worker of the parallel run and in the serial run.
releaseNotes: The examples runner sets __file__ to the path of each example, in the parallel and in the serial run, so that examples finding their data beside their file - staubliTX2blending.py, staubliTX2trajectories.py - run as when started directly; all 196 examples pass.
